title: Kids' Product Recalls

recalls.title: SHEIN Distribution Corporation Recalls Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking; Violate Mandatory Small Parts Ban
recalls.hazard: Purple and orange knobs can detach from the baby rattle and teether set and choke young children. The affected set has SKU sk25070936134444119.
recalls.remedy: Take the recalled set away from children immediately and contact SHEIN for a refund. SHEIN will ask you to confirm that you disposed of the set.
